doc: A fire (design/submit.md, Fire), as a config entry the runtime's fire system draws: its flames' colours, size, height, and flicker, its smoke, and the light it throws. Buildings' fire points name one by its id.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Its id, as fire points and themes name it (stable: never reused).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What burns: flames, embers (a glow with few flames: a forge's bed), or a spirit fire (flames that hold their colour and throw no smoke).

fields.name: core_color
fields.doc: The flames' colour at their root.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: How wide the fire is at its root, metres.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: How high its flames reach, metres.

fields.name: rate
fields.doc: Flame particles a second at full strength.

fields.name: smoke_size
fields.doc: A puff's size as it leaves, metres (it grows as it rises).

fields.name: smoke_life
fields.doc: How long a puff lasts, seconds.

fields.name: smoke_rise
fields.doc: How fast smoke rises, metres a second (the wind carries it too).

fields.name: light_radius
fields.doc: How far its light reaches, metres.

fields.name: light_strength
fields.doc: How bright its light is at its strongest.
